name: Ceiling fan plan mark
summary: Plan mark for a ceiling sweep fan, showing blade positions around a central outlet.
description: Ceiling fans are drawn on lighting plans as a central circle with blades radiating out, sometimes combined with a light symbol where a light kit is fitted. The form tells the installer to provide a fan-rated support at the ceiling and a controller at the wall.

The plan should also show the controller, which may be a speed controller, a combined fan-light switch or a remote receiver. Clearance from walls and from luminaires is a common coordination check. The mark does not state the sweep diameter or motor rating. These come from the fixture schedule.
readingNotes: Check the support requirement for the fan weight and torque.
distinction: An extract fan moves air out of a room; a ceiling sweep fan circulates air within it.
